quiz.explain: Main is a valid method name, so javac compiles it. The JVM only starts a method named exactly main.

quiz.explain: JEP 512 is final in Java 25: the compiler makes an implicit class. In Java 23 it was a preview.

quiz.q: A file contains public class Main. What must the file be called?
quiz.explain: A public top-level class needs a file with exactly the same name, case included. Main.class is the bytecode javac produces.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT a Java keyword?
quiz.explain: main is an identifier (a name), not a keyword.

quiz.q: What is a block in Java?
options: Zero or more statements between braces { }
quiz.explain: Hello World has two blocks: the class body and the main method body.

quiz.q: Which JDK and style should you use for the Hyperskill projects in IntelliJ?

JDK 23 with the classic public class and public static void main

quiz.explain: Hyperskill's checks run on JDK 23, where compact source files are only a preview.

quiz.q: In Java 25, what does a bare println("Hi") (without IO. or System.out.) do in a compact source file?
quiz.explain: In Java 23's preview the IO methods were imported automatically. In final Java 25 you must write IO.println.
